name: vault-wiki
description: Per-kind templates for wiki entity notes, and research-backed expansion of thin notes into cited reference cards from canonical sources.

tools.name: vault_wiki
tools.description: Install the seven vault-owned wiki templates, and expand wiki entity notes by drafting from canonical sources on the chat service, reviewing in batches on the thinking service, and rewriting only the sections the kind spec declares managed; every write is backed up, journaled, and revertible, and runs are inspectable with review/status/doctor.

safety.modifies_existing_note_bodies: managed sections only, enforced by a byte-comparison of everything else
